At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard. 

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund https://foundersfund.com, Bessemer Venture Partners https://www.bvp.com/, BOND, https://www.bondcap.com/ DCVC https://www.dcvc.com/, Blackbird https://www.blackbird.vc/, Promus Ventures https://www.promusventures.com/, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures https://www.icehouseventures.co.nz/?utm_term=icehouse%20ventures&utm_campaign=Brand+Keywords&utm_source=adwords&utm_medium=ppc&hsa_acc=4064636360&hsa_cam=16902737884&hsa_grp=134004309485&hsa_ad=592971340272&hsa_src=g&hsa_tgt=kwd-1082530126230&hsa_kw=icehouse%20ventures&hsa_mt=b&hsa_net=adwords&hsa_ver=3&gclid=Cj0KCQjw2v-gBhC1ARIsAOQdKY0J0DepRVFDmjQlAkJPbZuQnLSA5UVzUzOXYiPxkjX-SeVa513_BhkaAr-MEALw_wcB.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Farmers make better decisions when they know what's happening in their paddocks and across their herds. The data we collect on the ground is what makes that possible. Every measurement feeds the systems that power our platform.

This role owns that pipeline end to end. You'll build and lead our in-field data collection operation: recruiting and training regional contractors, designing the protocols they follow, and defining how we capture pasture, forage, and animal data. You'll be the person who turns "we need ground truth data on X" into a crew in a paddock collecting it well, and makes sure what comes back is ready to power our next generation of value delivery to farmers.

Office-based with regular trips into the field. You'll work closely with our machine learning team, but you don't need to be one of them. If you've run field trials, led agronomic research, or managed distributed field crews, this is built for you.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

Build and lead the field collection crew

 - Recruit, onboard, and retain a network of regional contractors who collect data on our behalf

 - Train collectors on protocols, tools, and quality standards, and keep them sharp as those evolve

 - Manage day-to-day operations across regions, including scheduling, logistics, and seasonal ramp-ups

Design how we collect data

 - Define and document protocols for capturing pasture, forage, and animal data in the field

 - Evaluate and roll out new collection techniques and technologies as the platform grows

 - Get out in the field regularly to pressure-test protocols and spot issues before they become patterns

Own data quality and flow

 - Make sure data coming in is consistent, accurate, and fit for use

 - Build feedback loops between collectors and the engineering team so issues get caught and corrected fast

 - Grow our datasets over time, balancing coverage, quality, and cost

Partner with the machine learning teams

 - Translate model needs into collection plans the field crew can actually execute

 - Flag what's working, what's not, and where the next investment should go



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Demonstrated ownership of a process comparable to a data/annotation operation end-to-end (collection and/or labelling), including quality systems and delivery against schedules.

 - Comfort translating ambiguous engineering team needs into precise operational specs: label definitions, edge-case handling, escalation rules, and measurable acceptance criteria.

 - Capability to move with urgency: Of the Halter Operating principles, moving with urgency is particularly relevant. Data collection is one of the most laborious phases of model development. The faster it moves, the faster we can deliver value to farmers and ranchers.

 - Strong service mindset: you are passionate about making the cross-functional system work, and passionate about the success of your client teams (ML engineering teams).
   


OUR OFFICE FIRST APPROACH

There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world-class, in-person office culture is the best way for high-performing teams. 

Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.

We’re office first, not office only. This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter. 

Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back - the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.




JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

This is a rare opportunity to build something genuinely new, leading a team and getting Halter up and running in a region with enormous potential for cattle producers.

You’ll own the operational system for the region from the ground up. You’ll be the first point of escalation when things get tricky in the field, and the person who makes sure the right people are in the right place at the right time.

You’ll work closely with dedicated teams in South America, the United States, and at Halter’s Auckland HQ. You’ll play a key role in making sure our pioneering producers in the region get an unmatched experience from day one.

 - Lead and develop your team: Lead, coordinate, and support a team of Fleet Ops Specialists across day-to-day operations. Support their growth, give great feedback, and help them focus on what matters.

 - Performance management: Own performance management for your team. Set clear expectations, hold people accountable, and help everyone do their best work.

 - Planning and scheduling: Plan and schedule team workloads to make sure the right people are in the right place at the right time across the region.

 - Recruitment: Lead recruitment activities to keep the team resourced and all roles filled across South America.

 - First point of escalation: Be the go-to person when things get tricky in the field. Help your team find solutions quickly and keep operations moving.

 - Own the maintenance system: Build out, improve, and own the maintenance system for the South American market. Make sure the team runs it consistently.

 - Hands-on when it counts: Get hands-on with maintenance, hardware upkeep, and repairs when needed. You’re a player-coach, not just a manager.

 - Hardware diagnosis: Diagnose hardware issues in the field and feed findings back to the relevant internal teams quickly.

 - Deployment support: Provide on-site and remote support during farm deployments including drone mapping, installs, go-live, and collaring. Own the scheduling and execution of collaring activities on new and existing farms.

 - On-call: Support the global on-call roster for hardware-related incidents and make sure your team is well set up to do the same.

 - Data and insights: Collect, interpret, and analyse data from our hardware to optimise processes, resolve issues proactively, and inform decision-making. Track team output and surface insights to improve how the team works.

 - Field insights: Feed learnings back clearly to our product and engineering teams, so we’re always building what matters most for South American cattle producers.

 - Collaboration: Work closely across Halter’s teams to stay aligned and drive strong customer outcomes.

 - Travel: With producers and your team spread across South America, you’ll be on the road regularly. Expect 3 to 4 days a week and some nights away from home.

 - Whatever else it takes: This is an early-stage market entry. You’ll do what needs doing to make Halter succeed in South America.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Commercial Strategy Analyst, you'll be part of the engine behind Halter's strategic decisions. You'll be building models, sizing opportunities, and running qualitative and quantitative analysis that shows us where to play. When the Commercial Strategy team needs to know whether a bet is worth making, they'll come to you to help build the case.

This is a role for someone who loves getting into the data and building up research. You'll turn ambiguous questions into clean, decision-ready analysis: market and opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analysis, competitor analysis and broader industry trends. You'll make the complex feel simple, and give the team clear answers they can act on fast.

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Halter's commercial, finance, and product teams, supporting the initiatives that shape our future. You'll move between deep-focus analysis at your desk, pulling data from across the business, as well as getting out to meet farmers and ranchers so your thinking is grounded in reality.

This is a rare opportunity to build foundational analytical skills at one of the most transformative companies in agriculture - and to see your analysis directly shape major commercial decisions.




WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Own the quantitative analysis that underpins the Commercial Strategy team's decisions.

 - Source and analyse the information we need to help answer questions like where to play and how to win.

 - Pull together market data, competitive intelligence, and macro trends to keep our analysis current.

 - Support opportunity assessments for new markets, partnerships, and monetisation models with the sizing and financial structure behind them.

 - Translate your analysis into clear, concise charts and narratives that execs and frontline teams can quickly act on.

 - Partner with the Commercial Strategy Managers to take their initiatives from plan to landed outcome, owning the analytical workstream.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You love using numbers to help tell the story. Modelling in Excel or Sheets is second nature, and you take pride in files that are tidy, editable, and give clear answers without a 20-minute tour.

 - You can take a messy, ambiguous problem and build the data (qualitative and quantitative) that reveals the answer. You're comfortable getting an answer with half the information and refining as you learn more.

 - You're commercially curious.  You want to understand the levers of the business and how they move.

 - You're rigorous and detail-oriented. You double-check your work, sanity-test your outputs, and don't let a wrong number slip through.

 - You communicate crisply. You can turn a complex analysis into a simple chart or one-pager that people remember and can get behind.

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to be one of Halter's first Regional Sales Managers in Uruguay — one of the world's great cattle nations — building our customer presence in the region from the ground up.

We're looking for a go-getter who is out in the field, meeting farmers, championing Halter and converting them into our very first local customers. A 'never give up attitude' is crucial for this role; as our first sales hire on the ground, you will be a foundational contributor to the growth and success of Halter in Uruguay.

You'll be responsible for using your strong sales background to drive end-to-end sales, from cold calling and on-farm meetings to deeply understanding our customers' farm systems. You'll detail Halter's value proposition, progress the sale, and ultimately close the deal. As the region scales, you'll help shape how we set quotas and commissions, build sales capability, and mentor the team that follows you. Make your mark with Halter and help us push the boundaries of farming, connecting animals and humans like never before.



WHAT YOUR DAY COULD LOOK LIKE

 - Sourcing new leads and opportunities through proactive outreach, referrals/introductions, industry events and other channels, as well as fielding and responding to inbound inquiries.

 - Meeting high growth sales targets by managing pipeline through to close, including screening, qualifying, executing on-farm demonstrations and successfully negotiating contracts with customers.

 - Laying the groundwork for the local sales function — helping to set and manage quotas, commissions and other sales management tasks as the team grows.

 - Coaching, mentoring and developing future sales staff to help drive their professional growth and reach targets as we scale the region.

 - Collaborating with Customer Success to ensure successful post-sales handoff, implementations, customer satisfaction and account renewal.

 - Providing support, insight and communication to help build and foster trusting and enduring relationships with customers as they wait for deployment.

 - Leveraging opportunities and participating in relevant industry/Halter events and demonstrations.

 - Building and leveraging industry relationships to establish and maintain Halter's brand in a brand-new market.

 - Focusing on the customer and their needs, providing feedback to help drive the product roadmap.

 - Working with the team to optimise and evolve the sales process to become faster, more efficient and more predictable as the company scales.
   


WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR 

 - A complete end-to-end sales skill set with at least five years of experience.

 - Proven track records and examples of successfully sourcing new prospects, securing meetings with new leads and creating new sales opportunities.

 - Someone highly experienced in value-based sales with a proven history of closing deals and high-volume sales results.

 - Well-prepared with solid communication skills to present Halter's value proposition.

 - Experience in beef farming or within the agricultural sector is highly desirable.

 - A person who is results-driven, highly motivated with exceptional time management skills.

 - Adaptability in a high-stakes sales environment and the ability to think on your feet — comfort with the ambiguity of building in a new market is a big plus.

 - Sales experience in the technology-based industry is preferred.

 - Fluency in Spanish, with professional working English to collaborate across our global team.

 - A university degree or equivalent would be excellent but not a must.
   


HALTER IN URUGUAY

This is a founding role as Halter establishes itself in the region — meaning enormous scope to shape how an entire industry adopts virtual fencing technology. You'll be building from the ground up: our first customers, our first relationships, and the foundation of our local team. These opportunities don't come around often.






JOIN OUR TEAM

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page https://www.halterhq.com/careers for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/halter-limited & Instagram https://www.instagram.com/lifeathalter/.




WHY OUR TEAM LOVES WORKING AT HALTER:

 - Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

 - Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

 - You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.

 - This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

We're searching for an exceptional marketing leader to grow Halter in this region to one of Halter's biggest markets in the world. We've made our first moves on the ground and now we need a senior leader to build on that foundation.

This role is a key driver of North America's full-funnel revenue performance: acquisition, expansion, and retention, all through marketing. You're not running events and content on instruction or directive from HQ. You are accountable for the region's marketing strategy to achieve our revenue outcomes. That means thinking like a revenue owner first, and a marketer second.

Your job is to make sure marketing shows up as a genuine lever across that whole funnel: helping win new ranchers, and also feeding the stories, proof points and community that keeps existing ranchers expanding and retained.  You, in tight collaboration with go-to-market leadership, will build this strategy, build the team to deliver against it, and own the demand and pipeline that drives Halter's growth in this market for years to come.

You will have full support from Halter’s global marketing team based in New Zealand HQ, with the brand and strategic frameworks you need to do your job - think of this as our DNA and standardised thinking and that lets every region move fast without reinventing the wheel. We are building the feedback loop to take your feedback and wins, and globalise them, to make Halter’s marketing brilliant in all of our key markets. But ultimately the buck stops with you in this region - acquire, expand and retain the best ranches in one of the best ranching regions globally.




WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 - A full-funnel revenue thinker, not a channel specialist. You've owned acquisition, expansion, and retention outcomes, not just top-of-funnel demand generation. You think in pipeline and revenue contribution first, achieved through strategically driving brand awareness

 - Deeply customer-led. You're energised by time on ranch with customers, and you turn that understanding into commercial decisions such as messaging, proof points, and channel choices, not just generic content ideas.

 - A builder and world-class operator.   You will build and lead a high-performing, efficient team, ideally with experience scaling a marketing or growth function in a fast paced environment.  You will be comfortable rolling your sleeves up and playing ‘executor’, while also knowing the right time to give space to your team to win (or lose) and learn from that experience

 - Genuinely commercial. You’re not just comfortable being measured on a revenue number - you demand it from yourself and your team. You move fast on real bets, you’re allergic to decisions not backed by data, and you thrive on seeing real results in real time.

 - First-principles by instinct. You use Halter's global frameworks because they're smart, not because you're told to, and you know exactly when your regional market demands something different, and can make that case with evidence, not opinion.

 - A strong operator across both brand and demand.  You’re equally comfortable in a tone-of-voice conversation and a CAC/ROI conversation, and you’re able to move between the two with ease

 - Comfortable with ambiguity. You'd rather own the outcome and figure out the path than wait for a fully specified brief.

 - AI-forward as a default operating mode, not a tool you occasionally reach for. You and your team use AI to draft and iterate content, personalise outreach at a scale a human team couldn't match manually, and analyse campaign and funnel data faster than a traditional team would. You treat headcount as a last resort after you've pressure-tested what AI can already do, not the other way around.




WHAT THE ROLE LOOKS LIKE

 - Strategy & ownership: Own the regional marketing strategy and budget end to end, setting the vision and the plan to take Halter from early-market entry to category leadership and one of our largest revenue markets.

 - Organic growth, brand equity, and content.  You are accountable for the organic channel’s contribution to pipeline and CAC, not just for content output.  Own the thesis for how Halter earns trusted-voice status in your market without paying for attention every time, and through data driven decision making decide where and how to invest resource across organic vs paid. Build a content strategy that compounds: SEO-driven rancher resources, owned channels, and organic social, be clear on what ‘compounding’ actually means in this market (search, community, category education), and know when to kill channels that aren't compounding.

 - Events strategy.  This sits at the heart of our territory manager regional model. You'll partner with sales leadership to decide which field days, expos, and rancher gatherings actually move pipeline in North America, and how they connect directly into the territory manager's patch and pipeline, not run as a separate marketing calendar.

 - Case studies & proof.  Build a library of local customer stories and results that do double duty: acquisition proof points for new ranchers, and expansion/retention proof points for existing ones.

 - Paid traffic.  Work with the Performance Marketing function running paid channels in-region with a sharp eye on CAC and pipeline contribution, not just reach or impressions.

 - Enterprise motion.  Support and drive the enterprise/larger-account pipeline in North America specifically, where the buying committee, proof requirements, and sales cycle look different from owner-operator ranches.

 - Accountability for the numbers: Own and report on pipeline, CAC, brand awareness and the complete revenue picture of this region.  Marketing is one of the most critical levers that sits right across the funnel, so it’s expected you will design the marketing strategy around each metric from acquisition through to NDR.

 - Brand and tone of voice in-region.  Use Halter's global brand as the foundation, and make the judgment calls on how it lands with your regional customers specifically: language, imagery, humour, what plays and what doesn't in this market.

 - Objection handling through stories, not just spec sheets.  Build ROI case studies and compelling storytelling, delivered through the right channels at the right point in the funnel, that neutralise the objections ranchers actually raise (price, proof, switching risk), not generic feature messaging.

 - Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP): Own a part of Halter and share in our growth and success

 - Unlimited PTO: Take time off when you need it—no accrual required, available from day one

 - Comprehensive health benefits: Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting the first day of the month after you join (with most premiums covered, including 100% of employee-only health premiums on select plans)

 - Personal growth fund: $750 USD per year to support learning, development, or personal growth goals

 - Parental leave: 16 weeks paid leave for birthing parents and 8 weeks paid leave for non-birthing parents

 - 401(k): 100% match on the first 3% contributed, plus 50% match on the next 2% (up to a 4% employer match), with immediate vesting
